scope: Focused manual source review, safe API security testing, independent dependency/secret scans; NOT comprehensive automated SAST or penetration test
reviewed_controls: CSV: leading =,+,-,@,tab,CR neutralization; actual parser tests
XLSX: literal string cells, typed dates/counts, corrected used range
PDF: bounded export and embedded local fonts; shaped text
Documents: bounded bytes/count, normalized filename, attachment/no-store/nosniff
Notes: owner restriction, literal rendering, private-text exclusion from timeline
SQL: bound data parameters and constrained sort fields
Compose/image: non-root backend, read-only filesystem, dropped capabilities; developer image evidence separated
limitations: No full automated Java/TS SAST engine executed
99 verified Maven coordinates queried; one embedded jarmode-tools JAR not identified by this method
PDF signature checks do not constitute content sanitization or malware scanning; no new acceptance criterion invented
